title: Geometric Area Evaluation for a Piecewise Linear Integral
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate int_{-2}^3 (2x + 4) dx by interpreting the integral as net signed area of geometric regions.

steps.title: Determine the Sign of the Integrand
steps.explanation: Over [-2, 3], f(x) >= 0 everywhere, so the integral represents a single right trapezoid.
steps.why: Net area equals geometric area when f(x) is non-negative.

steps.title: Calculate Geometric Heights and Base
steps.explanation: The region is a right triangle with base 5 and height 10.

steps.title: Compute Area
steps.why: Equivalence of definite integral and planar area.
